title: Second-order Leibniz sum at the identity matrix equals (tr B)² − tr(B·B)
statement: Let ι be a finite index set with decidable equality and let B be a real ι×ι matrix. Write I for the ι×ι identity matrix, so I_{ab} = δ_{ab}. For m ∈ ι let ι∖{m} be the finite set of indices different from m, and for l ∈ ι∖{m} let (ι∖{m})∖{l} = ι∖{m, l}. Then Σ_{σ∈Perm(ι)} sgn(σ) · Σ_{m∈ι} [Σ_{l∈ι∖{m}} (Π_{j∈(ι∖{m})∖{l}} I_{σ(j) j}) · B_{σ(l) l}] · B_{σ(m) m} = (tr B)² − tr(B·B). Here Perm(ι) is the finite group of permutations of ι, sgn(σ) ∈ {1, −1} is regarded as a real number, tr is the trace and B·B is the matrix product.
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ), ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∑ m : ι, (∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, (∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase m).erase l, (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (σ j) j) * B (σ l) l) * B (σ m) m = B.trace ^ 2 - (B * B).trace
